items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: Orders start at 5 keychains. The unit price decreases with volume, down to €1.70 per unit from 250 pieces.

items.q: Which logo formats do you accept?
items.a: PNG, JPG or SVG. If your logo isn't vector-based, we can vectorise it (any extra cost is communicated and approved before production).

items.q: What does the NFC chip do?
items.a: When tapped with a smartphone, it instantly opens the destination of your choice: website, contact card (vCard), social profile or Google review page. The destination is programmed according to your choice at order time.

items.q: Can the chip destination be changed after delivery?
items.a: The destination is programmed at order time. An editable redirect option (hosted by 3BeeStudio) can be offered separately; it is not part of the base offer.
Almost all recent smartphones: iPhone (XS and newer, automatic reading) and NFC-enabled Android devices. No app to install.
Keychains are 3D printed in France. Allow 5 to 10 business days. Shipping is free from 100 units.

items.q: Does the keychain need a battery?
items.a: No, no battery is required. NFC (Near Field Communication) technology is passive: the chip is powered by the electromagnetic field emitted by the phone when it reads it. The keychain works indefinitely, with no maintenance or charging.

legalCgv.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale
legalCgv.body:
3BeeStudio — Micro-enterprise
VALETTE Valentin — 144 rue de la République, 69220 Belleville-en-Beaujolais, France

Article 1 — Purpose

These Terms and Conditions of Sale (T&Cs) govern the contractual relationship between 3BeeStudio and any customer wishing to purchase a product or service offered on the site 3beestudio.fr. Any order implies unreserved acceptance of these T&Cs.

Article 2 — Products and services

3BeeStudio offers two types of orders:

  • Stock items: products available in the shop, shipped within 48h to 5 business days.
  • Custom creations: objects designed and made to the customer's specifications. A quote is issued before any production. A 50% deposit is required when ordering.
  • Connected keychains: custom 3D keychains with a built-in NFC chip. The NFC chip destination is programmed according to the choice indicated by the customer when ordering.
  • Logo vectorisation: if the logo is supplied in a non-vector format (PNG, JPG), conversion to a vector format (SVG) may be charged as an extra. The additional cost is communicated and accepted before any production.
  • Downloadable 3D files: digital models delivered via download link, with no shipment (see article 6a).

All objects are made in France. Photos and visuals are provided for illustration only; slight colour variations may appear depending on the filament used.

Article 3 — Prices

Prices are shown in euros, all taxes included. As a micro-enterprise, 3BeeStudio is not subject to VAT (article 293 B of the French Tax Code). Prices may be changed at any time; the applicable price is the one displayed at the time of the order.

Shipping costs are indicated at the time of payment and are payable by the customer, unless otherwise stated during a promotional offer.

Article 4 — Order and payment

Orders are placed directly on the site. Payment is secured via Stripe and accepts bank cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) as well as compatible payment solutions.

For custom creations, the order is confirmed upon receipt of the 50% deposit. The balance is paid on delivery or before shipping.

3BeeStudio reserves the right to cancel any order in the event of an availability issue or an obvious error in the price.

Article 5 — Delivery

  • Stock items: shipped within 2 to 5 business days.
  • Custom creations: lead time specified in the quote (generally 7 to 14 days).
  • Delivery within mainland France by carrier (Colissimo or equivalent).
  • A tracking number is provided by email as soon as the order ships.

In the event of a delivery delay attributable to the carrier, 3BeeStudio cannot be held responsible but undertakes to support the customer in resolving the issue.

Article 5a — Packaging and environmental approach

Orders are shipped in second-hand boxes, collected from our filament suppliers and other partners, then checked before reuse. Protective filling is likewise reused whenever its condition allows.

This is a deliberate choice: it avoids manufacturing a brand-new box for every order. A box may therefore show signs of use, crossed-out labels or the logo of its previous sender — none of which affects the protection of the contents or the condition of the product delivered. Should a parcel reach you damaged, article 7 (Warranties) applies as normal.

Article 6 — Right of withdrawal

In accordance with article L221-18 of the French Consumer Code, the customer has a period of 14 days from receipt to exercise their right of withdrawal, without justification, for stock products.

Exception: the right of withdrawal does not apply to products made to the customer's specifications (custom, personalised keychains), in accordance with article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code.

To exercise this right, contact us at contact@3beestudio.fr. Return costs are payable by the customer. The refund is made within 14 days of receiving the return.

Article 6a — Digital products (3D files)

3BeeStudio sells downloadable 3D files (STL, 3MF, STEP or archive). These products involve no shipment and no delivery fees.

Delivery. Download links are made available on the order tracking page immediately after payment confirmation, and sent by email. Each link is valid for 30 days and limited to 10 downloads per file. In case of trouble, access is reopened on request at contact@3beestudio.fr.

Right of withdrawal. Under article L221-28 3° of the French Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised on digital content supplied on an intangible medium where performance began after the customer's prior express consent and express waiver of that right. This waiver is collected through a mandatory checkbox at checkout and timestamped. Without it, the order cannot be placed.

Licence. Purchase grants a personal, non-exclusive right of use: printing for private use, in any quantity. Resale, redistribution, file sharing and commercial use are excluded without written consent from 3BeeStudio. Files remain the intellectual property of 3BeeStudio.

No print-result warranty. The outcome depends on the printer, material and settings used by the customer. 3BeeStudio warrants the conformity and integrity of the delivered file, not the result obtained on third-party hardware.

Article 7 — Warranties

All products benefit from the legal warranty of conformity (articles L217-4 et seq. of the French Consumer Code) and the warranty against hidden defects (articles 1641 et seq. of the French Civil Code).

In the event of a defective product, contact us as soon as possible with supporting photos. We will proceed with replacement or refund depending on the case.

Article 8 — Liability

3BeeStudio cannot be held responsible for indirect damage related to the use of the products. Liability is limited to the amount of the order concerned.

Article 9 — Personal data

The data collected when ordering is used solely for processing and delivering the order. See our Privacy policy for more information.

Article 10 — Disputes

In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution will be sought as a priority. Failing that, the customer may resort to mediation via the European online dispute resolution platform: ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.

These T&Cs are governed by French law. Any dispute will be submitted to the jurisdiction of the courts of Villefranche-sur-Saône.

legalPrivacy.title: Privacy policy
legalPrivacy.body:
3BeeStudio places the utmost importance on protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and your rights as a user.

1. Data controller

3BeeStudio — Micro-enterprise
VALETTE Valentin — 144 rue de la République, 69220 Belleville-en-Beaujolais, France
SIREN: 931 419 550 · SIRET: 931 419 550 00039
contact@3beestudio.fr

2. Data collected

When placing an order

  • First name, last name, email address
  • Delivery address
  • Payment data (processed directly by Stripe, not stored by 3BeeStudio)
  • Order history

While browsing

  • Anonymised browsing data (pages visited, duration)
  • IP address (anonymised)
  • Browser and device type

Via the contact form / newsletter

  • Email address
  • Message content (contact form)

3. Purposes of processing

  • Order processing: management, production, shipping, invoicing
  • Communication: order confirmation, delivery tracking, after-sales service
  • Newsletter: sending our news (with explicit consent)
  • Site improvement: anonymous audience analysis
  • Legal obligations: retention of accounting data

4. Legal basis

  • Performance of the contract (orders)
  • Consent (newsletter, non-essential cookies)
  • Legal obligation (accounting data)
  • Legitimate interest (service improvement)

5. Retention period

  • Order data: 5 years (accounting obligation)
  • Newsletter data: until unsubscription
  • Browsing data: 13 months maximum

6. Data sharing

Your data is never sold. It may be shared only with:

  • Stripe: secure payment (Stripe policy)
  • Carriers: for delivery (name, address)
  • Vercel: site hosting (Vercel policy)

7. Cookies

We use only cookies strictly necessary for the proper functioning of the site (session, cart). No advertising or third-party tracking cookie is placed without your consent.

8. Your rights (GDPR)

In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:

  • Right of access: obtain a copy of your data
  • Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
  • Right to erasure: delete your data
  • Right to portability: receive your data in a readable format
  • Right to object: object to certain processing
  • Right to withdraw consent: at any time for the newsletter

To exercise these rights: contact@3beestudio.fr. We will respond within 30 days. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (French data protection authority).

9. Security

We implement technical and organisational measures to protect your data (HTTPS connection, restricted access, secure hosting). Payment data is processed directly by Stripe and never passes through our servers.

10. DPO contact

For any question regarding your personal data:
contact@3beestudio.fr
